tasks.title: Subscribe to Official YouTube Channel
tasks.description: Subscribe to Waqar Official Channel, like the latest video, and submit your channel name or screenshot.
tasks.instructions:
1. Visit YouTube and search for Waqar Earn Official.
2. Click Subscribe and hit the bell icon.
3. Like the featured video.
4. Enter your YouTube username and screenshot link in the proof box.

tasks.title: Submit Positive 5-Star Rating & Review
tasks.titleUrdu: پلے اسٹور پر 5 اسٹار ریویو دیں
tasks.description: Leave a 5-star rating and positive review on the Waqar Earn app/portal. Mention fast payments in PKR.
tasks.instructions:
1. Provide a thoughtful 5-star review.
2. Take a screenshot or copy the review text.
3. Paste the review text and your reviewer name below.

tasks.title: Share Waqar Earn Proof in 3 Earning Groups
tasks.titleUrdu: واٹس ایپ ارننگ گروپس میں شیئر کریں
tasks.description: Share payment screenshot and announcement in 3 active Pakistani WhatsApp earning groups.
tasks.instructions:
1. Share with group members.
2. Submit group names and verification text.

tasks.title: Daily Platform Survey & Questionnaire
tasks.titleUrdu: روزانہ سروے اور سوالنامہ مکمل کریں
tasks.description: Answer 3 short feedback questions about your experience on Waqar Earn.pk to help us improve.
tasks.instructions: Answer: How did you discover us? Which payment method do you prefer (EasyPaisa/JazzCash)? What is your daily target in PKR?
